threat_event: Patient names and addresses are disclosed to corporate payroll beyond what pay processing needs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Visit-pay interface sends identifiers; intercompany BAA does not cover payroll
treatment_plan: Anonymous visit IDs; purge; BAA amendment (GR-10)

threat_event: Ransomware enters through an unprotected field tablet and spreads to agency offices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 28% of tablets without EDR; legacy device management
treatment_plan: Move tablets to group endpoint management with EDR
owner: Home Health security and compliance lead

threat_event: Lost or stolen field tablet with cached PHI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tablets travel to homes and cars
owner: Home Health security and compliance lead

threat_event: EHR vendor outage stops point-of-care documentation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Offline mode covers scheduled visits only
treatment_plan: Downtime drill each region each year

threat_event: Workforce members view patient records without a work reason and are not detected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: EHR access reports reviewed monthly; not in the SIEM

threat_event: Emergency plan does not cover a cyber outage, so patients needing evacuation cannot be listed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Priority list printed weekly; plan assumes EHR availability
treatment_plan: Add cyber outage to the all-hazards risk assessment; daily print during declared emergencies

threat_event: Staff follow the 2023 Home Health standards that conflict with group policy
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Supplement last aligned 2023 (termination next business day; 90-day logs)
owner: Home Health security and compliance lead

threat_event: Home Health cannot show which HIPAA safeguards group controls meet
Per diem clinicians' EHR accounts stay active after their assignments end
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Staffing assignment end dates not fed to the EHR
treatment_plan: Assignment end feed from Staffing to the EHR
owner: Home Health security and compliance lead

threat_event: Hospitalization risk model uses age and disability-related inputs without a 92.210 review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Model enabled by the EHR vendor in 2025; no input review

threat_event: Ambient documentation pilot records patients or family members without consent
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot in 6 agencies; consent step is a verbal reminder

threat_event: Agency office staff are phished, leading to email compromise and referral or remittance fraud
owner: Home Health security and compliance lead

Paper downtime forms lost in the field
treatment_plan: Accepted: paper use is rare and logged
owner: Home Health security and compliance lead

threat_event: Hurricane disrupts visits and agency offices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: All 5 states on the Gulf or Atlantic coast

threat_event: Field staff text PHI on personal phones
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No approved secure messaging on all devices
